SUTR-3 — SuperUnicode Storage

Partitions, formats and the mount policy.

Storage is governed by the OpenWindows Storage specification. A SuperUnicode Partition is a removable filesystem whose layout is declared by SuperUnicode machine instructions.

Format Description
OWFS Native drive filesystem; data starts at offset 0x10000; CRC32c + Fletcher-64 integrity; ow_sec identity; optional ChaCha20 at-rest encryption.
USFS Portable external-media filesystem.

Policy summary

  • Base SuperUnicode Partitions may be OWFS or USFS, and are used for bugfix and rescue payloads only.
  • Plugin Partitions are Extended-only and MUST be OWFS — never USFS.
  • All partitions mount read-only; plugin partitions mount only after the boot checksum gate.

Full policy text: partitions/spec.txt in both /Public trees.
